decisions.reason: As a recent but well-aligned two-component resin injection unit in a firm focused on coating and material-processing equipment, it likely remains in the portfolio unless demand proved clearly too narrow.
A second resin injection unit plausibly serves a different performance range or application niche, and established German machinery firms usually keep such complementary variants for several years.
An automatic airless spray gun fits the firm's core application-technology offering and is likely retained as part of its industrial systems range.
A manual airless spray gun is a classic core product with broad practical use and serviceability, so it is less likely to be withdrawn quickly.
The air-assisted airless spray gun is closely connected to the firm's established spraying business and likely stays unless replaced by a direct successor.
The data logger appears more peripheral to the firm's main hardware business and its reduced website prominence suggests weaker traction or a higher chance of discontinuation.
